description: This file is a plugin for CKEditor that adds resizable functionality to the editor interface, allowing users to resize the editor window horizontally, vertically, or both, with configurable constraints.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resize plugin, setting up event handlers and configuration for resizing the editor.

methods.name: dragHandler
methods.description: Handles the dragging motion to resize the editor, updating width and height within configured limits.

methods.name: dragEndHandler
methods.description: Handles the end of dragging, removing event listeners.
